title: DISCODE: Distribution-Aware Score Decoder for Robust Automatic Evaluation of Image Captioning

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the output token probability distributions of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) during evaluation tasks to identify if specific score tokens (e.g., the digit '0') are disproportionately frequent or overestimated, causing the score distribution to deviate from a natural, unimodal Gaussian distribution.
